description: Team crests on transparent backgrounds. Used on jerseys (composited in game), team pages, scoreboards and the kill feed.
style: Premium esports team logo: a bold, modern vector-style emblem, centered, filling about 80% of the frame, on a fully transparent background. Clean flat shapes with crisp edges, at most three colors plus a dark outline, subtle inner bevel allowed, readable at small sizes. Absolutely no words, letters, numbers or initials. Original design that does not imitate any existing sports, esports or company logo.
